__comment: A synthetic OTLP/HTTP trace payload, used to prove the telemetry pipeline
end to end before SlayIdleRepeat.Server emits anything of its own (M5-11).
Expect: HTTP 200 with {"partialSuccess":{}} from the collector, then the
service 'sir-pipeline-probe' appears in Jaeger at http://127.0.0.1:16686,
both increase in Prometheus. That is the whole road: OTLP in -> collector ->
Jaeger, with the collector's own metrics visible in Prometheus and Grafana.
The timestamps are fixed, so the span lands at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z rather
than 'now'. Widen Jaeger's time range if you cannot find it. Fixed values
keep this file byte-stable and reviewable; a template with a clock in it
would need a script, and this needs to work from a bare curl.
Unknown JSON members are ignored by the OTLP/JSON decoder, which is why this
comment block can live inside the payload itself. If a future collector
version rejects it, move the text into a sibling README rather than deleting

value.stringValue: prove OTLP -> collector -> Jaeger before M5-11 instruments the server
